report.advertisedClaim: The offer page does not advertise that Basic Economy tickets can be canceled any time for a full cash refund. It states that after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period, canceling a Basic ticket results in an eCredit minus a cancellation charge, not a cash refund.
report.policyFinding: The policy page clearly states that Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) tickets cannot be changed or refunded after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period. After this period, canceling a Basic Economy ticket results in an eCredit (not a cash refund), minus any applicable cancellation fees.
report.explanation: Both the offer and policy pages specify that Basic Economy tickets are non-refundable after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period. Canceling such a ticket after this window results in an eCredit (travel credit), not a refund to your original form of payment. Only refundable tickets or cancellations within 24 hours of purchase are eligible for a full cash refund. The claim that you can cancel a Basic Economy ticket any time for a full cash refund is directly contradicted by Delta's published terms.
importantConditions: Basic Economy tickets are only eligible for a full cash refund within 24 hours of purchase (risk-free cancellation period).
After 24 hours, canceling a Basic Economy ticket results in an eCredit minus a cancellation fee, not a cash refund.
Basic Economy tickets cannot be changed or refunded after the risk-free period, except for special circumstances (e.g., significant schedule change, flight cancellation by Delta).
Tickets must be canceled prior to departure to retain any value.

evidence.excerpt: If you purchased a non-refundable ticket such as Basic or Classic Travel Experience, you may cancel your ticket [prior to departure](https://www.delta.com/us/en/change-cancel/cancel-flight#noshowpolicy) and receive an eCredit, minus any applicable fees. The remaining value of your ticket after applicable fees are deducted will be issued as an eCredit.
Note: Customers who purchase Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) will not be able to change or refund their ticket after the Risk-Free Cancellation period.

If your plans change and you booked a non-refundable ticket, you can cancel your ticket for an eCredit minus any applicable [cancellation fees](https://www.delta.com/us/en/baggage/overview#changecancelfees). Classic and Basic tickets are nonrefundable.

As part of our [Customer Commitment](https://www.delta.com/us/en/legal/customer-commitment) for customers who book direct on delta.com or the Fly Delta app, Risk-Free Cancellation means that after you’ve purchased a qualifying eTicket, you have up to 24 hours after booking to cancel it for any reason and receive a full refund with no fees.

unansweredQuestions: What are the specific cancellation fees for Basic Economy tickets on your route?
Are there any exceptions for a cash refund on Basic Economy tickets due to special circumstances (e.g., illness, military orders)?
nextSteps: If you purchased your Basic Economy ticket within the last 24 hours, cancel immediately to receive a full cash refund.
If more than 24 hours have passed, you can cancel your ticket prior to departure to receive an eCredit (minus any applicable fees), not a cash refund.
Check the exact cancellation fee for your ticket on Delta's Baggage & Travel Fees page or in your booking details.
If your flight is canceled or significantly changed by Delta, you may be eligible for a cash refund—review those policies if applicable.
Contact Delta customer service if you believe you qualify for an exception or need clarification.
